title: Juuɗe Kuɗɗe
intro: Aɗa darii e laabi ɓuuɓɗi Makka ɓooyɗi, ɗo ruuhu jom doole e ngalu meeɗii ruttaade e noddaango goonga. Daartol ngol limre ko siftorde laaɓtunde wonde jokkondire ƴiiƴam mbaawaa foolde caɗeele mawnikinaare. Hol oo mo innde mum ina ɓuuɓtoo e yiite fadi?
clues: Miɗo yaha e laabi Makka e mawnikinaare ɓuuɓnde mi e goonga, hay so tawii nulaaɗo oo ko ƴiiƴam am.
Jawdi am ina yaaji, kono wonti kuddi wonaa ngaska.
Deftere njillu ina haala halkaare am, ina hollita wonde juuɗe am e neɗɗo am maa halku.
Jom suudu am naati e kampaañ am gaño, mooftude ƴiye ngam sarde e laawol nodduɗo Alla.
Ñalnde ñaawoore, mi lummbinee e yiite ɓuuɓɗo, jom suudu am ina jogoo ɓoggol fiɓnde paltoor e wutte mum.
Miɗo anndiraa innde firti ‘baaba lewlewndu’ — innde anndinde hoɗorde am haa abada.

trial.label: Ñaawoore walla Kewu Key
options: Luutndiima Nelaaɗo, o huɗaama e nder Quraan
Etaade warde Annabi e werlaade kaaƴe
trial.answer: Luutndiima Nelaaɗo, o huɗaama e nder Quraan

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: O naatat yiite wulnge, jawdi makko nafataa mo
O yaafaama caggal nde o reentini
outcome.answer: O naatat yiite wulnge, jawdi makko nafataa mo

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
